q: The verifier asks how we set our organisational boundary. What do we show?
title: Showing your boundary to a verifier
short: Show which entities and sites you included, the approach you chose (operational control, financial control or equity share), and documents that prove control: registration certificates, lease or ownership papers, and electricity connections in your name. List anything left out and why.
audience: MSMEs with several units, leased sheds or group companies

ul: GST and Udyam registrations for each unit.
Electricity and fuel accounts in the company's name.
A one-page boundary note naming the approach.
Units owned by family members but run by you.

p: Use the same boundary every year, or explain and restate when it changes.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements
